function.name: e2e_finance_case
function.description: [EaaS E2E Operating Model — A3.2 Finance Case] Structure the financing model for EaaS asset deployment — evaluating balance sheet, off-balance sheet, and third-party financing options against the contract economics. Outputs: Financing structure options analysis; Cost of capital and WACC impact assessment; Debt covenants and lender requirements review; Recommended financing structure with rationale.

asset_investment.description: Total asset investment required for the contract portfolio

balance_sheet_constraints.description: Any balance sheet or leverage constraints

financing_preferences.description: Preference for on or off balance sheet treatment
